title: Fort Keogh
geometryBasis: Present shed footprint and long axis interpreted from open federal aerial imagery beside the state historical marker.
sectionBasis: State historic register sign documents the unornamented brick exterior, hipped roof, arched windows and 2004 restoration. The opening arrangement and dimensions below the visible roof are estimated.
limitations: This represents the restored water wagon shed. The dispersed historic district and other photographed, demolished or relocated post buildings are outside this structure.
Roof footprint comes from the original overhead image; elevation and façade layout, arched window spacing, door orientation and finish colors are approximate.
